All SQL uses parameterized queries ($1, $2, ...); never interpolate values into SQL strings, even for ORDER BY — whitelist columns instead.
The 38ms p95 may regress with SERIALIZABLE retries under contention; re-run k6 after the retry change.
Day 12: fixing server.ts to register balanceRoutes; then add setErrorHandler for ZodError.
Prefers Makefile targets over raw npm scripts in instructions (make test-int, not npm run test:int).
CI occasionally fails at 'Initialize containers' with 'service postgres failed health check' when the runner is slow; rerunning the job fixes it.
Currency should become a z.enum of the ISO-4217 codes we support (USD, EUR, THB, JPY); planned for v0.4.
k6 load test scripts live in k6/ (not in repo yet); entries.js posts with random idempotency keys.
package-lock.json must be committed; CI uses npm ci which fails if the lockfile is out of sync with package.json.
npm run dev uses tsx watch; tsx doesn't type-check, so run npm run build (tsc) before committing.
Body.parse throws ZodError, which Fastify turns into a 500 unless setErrorHandler maps it to 400 — the handler is not written yet, so invalid bodies currently 500.
Error responses are { error: snake_case_code } with optional details; never return stack traces. Zod errors map to 400 { error: 'invalid_body', details: issues }.
Readiness endpoint /readyz runs SELECT 1 with a 500ms timeout; Kubernetes readinessProbe points at it, liveness stays on /healthz.
Bug: server.ts never registers balanceRoutes after the split, so GET /v1/accounts/:id/balance returns 404 — found in session 9, fix pending.
Local and CI Postgres should match prod major version; local moved to postgres:17-alpine but CI still uses 16 — align before relying on PG17-only features.
vitest.int.config.ts runs integration tests in a single fork (singleFork) so tests sharing the TRUNCATEd table don't race.
JWT verification lives in src/auth/verify.ts (renamed from jwt.ts); ES256 key from JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH, issuer ledger-api, audience ledger-clients, clockTolerance 30s.
Balance endpoint moved to src/routes/balance.ts (balanceRoutes); entries.ts now only has POST /v1/entries. server.ts must register both.
日本円(JPY)は小数点以下がないので、amountCentsは円そのものを表す。100倍しないこと。
ลูกค้าชาวไทยต้องการให้แสดงยอดเงินเป็นบาท (THB) โดยใช้ satang เป็นหน่วยย่อย; amountCents สำหรับ THB หมายถึงสตางค์
We should emit a metric for 40001 retries (ledger_tx_retries_total) so we notice contention before users do; not implemented.
Balance queries may get slow past ~5M entries per account; a materialized balance table might be needed. No data yet.
Decided in this session to postpone OpenAPI generation until the v1 routes stabilize.
Wants every new env var documented in README's Configuration table in the same PR.
Day 5: pagination route done, tests pending; next step is the readiness endpoint /readyz.
Load test baseline (k6, 200 VUs, 60s): POST /v1/entries p95 = 38ms, p99 = 95ms on a 2 vCPU staging box. Re-run k6/entries.js after changing the transaction path.
node-postgres named prepared statements (query({name: ...})) break under pgbouncer transaction mode with 'prepared statement "x" does not exist'; only use unnamed queries.
Prod sits behind pgbouncer in transaction pooling mode: no session state (SET, advisory locks, LISTEN/NOTIFY, prepared statements by name) survives between transactions.
keys/ is gitignored; generate a local ES256 keypair with: openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out keys/jwt.key && openssl ec -in keys/jwt.key -pubout -out keys/jwt.pub
LOG_LEVEL=debug makes Fastify log full request bodies including amountCents; fine locally, never in prod.
Integration tests TRUNCATE ledger_entries in beforeAll; never point TEST_DATABASE_URL at a shared dev database.
docker-compose db uses tmpfs for /var/lib/postgresql/data so every make db-up starts empty; run make migrate after db-up or tests fail with relation "ledger_entries" does not exist.
Negative amountCents are allowed (refunds/debits); validation regex is ^-?\d+$. Zero is allowed too — maybe it shouldn't be.
Idempotency keys never expire today (UNIQUE on ledger_entries.idempotency_key). A cleanup job was discussed but rejected: replays after months must still be safe.
Rate limiting (RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN, default 120) is configured but not wired up yet: @fastify/rate-limit is not installed. Don't assume requests are throttled.
GET /v1/accounts/:id/entries uses keyset (cursor) pagination on (created_at, id), not OFFSET; the cursor is base64url of 'created_at|id'. Page size max 200.
PG_POOL_MAX default raised to 20 after pgbouncer max_client_conn went to 100 (4 replicas x 20 = 80 < 100). Keep replicas x PG_POOL_MAX under max_client_conn.
Concurrent-writers test is stable now: withSerializableTx retries SQLSTATE 40001 up to 3 times (withRetry, 10-50ms jitter). If it flakes again, look at MAX_ATTEMPTS before anything else.
Currency is ISO-4217 3-letter code, validated only by length(3) in zod — 'XYZ' passes; a proper enum is on the backlog.
pgbouncer may need server_reset_query = DISCARD ALL for the startup -c options to persist; unverified.
Session 2: wrote the retry wrapper design: retry 40001 up to 3 times with jittered backoff (10-50ms).
Likes concise explanations; skip long summaries at the end of a task.
CI uses Node 20; local dev should use Node 20 too (top-level await in server.ts needs Node 14.8+, but fetch and test runner behavior differ in 18).
Graceful shutdown on SIGTERM closes Fastify first, then the pg pool; reversing the order caused 'Cannot use a pool after calling end' errors in-flight.
/healthz is unauthenticated and does not touch the DB (liveness only); a readiness check with SELECT 1 is still TODO.
Auth failures return 401 with error codes missing_token or invalid_token; never leak jose's error message to clients.
All timestamps are TIMESTAMPTZ and stored in UTC; the API returns ISO-8601 with Z.
ledger_entries has a composite index (account_id, created_at) for balance and listing queries; cursor pagination should order by (created_at, id).
Migrations are plain SQL files in migrations/ applied by node-pg-migrate (npm run migrate); never edit an applied migration, add a new numbered file.
gen_random_uuid() needs Postgres 13+ (built in) — the migration relies on it; no pgcrypto extension needed on PG16.
Fastify's JSON serializer throws 'Do not know how to serialize a BigInt' if a bigint reaches reply.send; convert amountCents with toString() before sending.

Dead end: tried SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on an accounts row instead of SERIALIZABLE; deadlocked under the concurrent-writers test because entries for two accounts lock in different orders. Don't retry this.
Working on: adding GET /v1/accounts/:id/entries with cursor pagination; route stub not written yet.
Uses pnpm at work but this repo uses npm (package-lock); do not switch package managers.
Wants tests written before fixing a bug (red-green), and dislikes mocking the database; prefers integration tests against real Postgres.
Prefers small PRs with one concern each, and conventional commit messages (feat:, fix:, chore:).
CI (GitHub Actions) runs npm test then npm run test:int against a postgres:16-alpine service on port 55432.
scripts/wait-for-pg.sh uses nc -z instead of pg_isready because brew's libpq does not put pg_isready on PATH on macOS.
We use Fastify 4 rather than Express: built-in schema validation hooks and ~2x throughput in our load test (k6, 2k rps).
Project is ESM (type: module, NodeNext). Relative imports must end in .js even in .ts files, e.g. import { getPool } from '../db/pool.js'; omitting .js gives ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND at runtime.
Config is validated with zod in loadConfig and the server fails fast at boot on invalid env (throws 'invalid config: ...'). Add every new env var to the Env schema in src/config.ts.
We chose jose over jsonwebtoken: jose is ESM-native, supports WebCrypto, and jsonwebtoken pulled in a vulnerable dependency (CVE in old semver).
statement_timeout is passed as a connection startup option (-c statement_timeout=...) instead of SET, because pgbouncer in transaction mode drops session-level SET.
Integration tests: make test-int (starts docker db, sets TEST_DATABASE_URL=[REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]localhost:55432/ledger_test). Plain npm test runs only unit tests.
Local Postgres for tests runs in docker compose on host port 55432 (not 5432, to avoid clashing with a brew postgres). Use make db-up.
Ledger writes run in SERIALIZABLE transactions via withSerializableTx; chosen over row locks because balance is computed with SUM over entries and we need phantom protection.
POST /v1/entries requires an Idempotency-Key header (min 8 chars); duplicates hit ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) and return the existing row instead of erroring.
Money is stored as BIGINT cents (amount_cents) and passed as bigint in TS; never use floats or JS number for amounts. API accepts/returns amountCents as a decimal string.
